steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a medium saucepan over medium heat, melt butter. Stir in the sugar and mix well. Stir in graham cracker crumbs. Pat the mixture into baking dish.
In a medium mixing bowl, beat together the eggs, sugar and cream cheese. Pour the mixture over crust.
Bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven. Remove from heat and allow the mixture to cool.
In a small bowl, dissolve the gelatin in water.

In a medium saucepan over medium heat, mix the pumpkin, eggs, milk, sugar, salt and cinnamon. Reserve the egg whites. Stirring constantly, cook until thick, about 4 minutes. Remove from heat and mix in the gelatin. Allow the mixture to cool for approximately 20 minutes.

In a small bowl, beat the 3 egg whites until stiff. Gently fold the egg whites into the cooled pumpkin mixture. Pour the pumpkin mixture over the cream cheese mixture. Top with whipped cream. Cover and refrigerate approximately 2 hours.

raw_recipe.headline: Pumpkin Cream Cheese Dessert
raw_recipe.description: This light and delicious three layered pumpkin dessert is a nice alternative to pumpkin pie. An easy to make graham cracker crust forms the foundation for cream cheese and pumpkin layers topped with whipped cream. This recipe contains raw eggs. We recommend that pregnant women, young children, the elderly and the infirm do not consume raw eggs.

review.reviewBody: I elimintated the raw egg whites whipped into the pumpkin mixture by substiting half of an 8 oz container of Cool Whip. IT was perfect. My husband said this dessert was "maybe my best ever". I shared it with all my neighbors & my husband took some to work. I can't tell you how many people reguested the recipe. 10++++

Since I didn't have gelatin I dissolved 2T cornstarch in the 1/4C milk and added it in with the rest of the ingredients. I doubled the cream cheese layer and lessened the crust then baked it for 35 minutes. My family loved it and has requested it for Thanksgiving. Thanks for an amazing recipe!

I have been making this dessert for many years as it is very popular with family members. As so many, I too, was concerned about the raw egg. I purchase pasteurized eggs to use in this recipe. Costs a little more, but who wants to take any chances?

This was an absolute hit! Everyone loved it. It didn't take too long to make or set in fridge and it was a nice light and cool alternative to pumpkin pie after a big dinner. There are a few changes I made. First - instead of a graham wafer crust I made a crust using a good quality ginger snap and left out the sugar. I added a few shakes of ground ginger and ground cloves along with the cinnamon. I believe the recipe should say 1/2 pint whipping cream, whipped as 1/2 pint (1 c.) of whipping cream is not near enough to spread on the top. When whipping up the 1/2 pt. of cream, add a tsp. of vanilla and a tbsp. or more, to individual taste, of icing sugar. Enjoy!

I love this recipe but to make it a little easier/faster i use a no bake creamcheese layer and people seem to like it more acutally. It's just 1 8oz softend creamcheese, 1 container cool whip, mix well and add sugar to desired sweetness and follow the rest of the recipe. At our family gatherings its the first dessert gone.lol.

I love pumpkin and this hit the spot. The directions were a little confusing so I did what I thought went together. The only change I made was I didn’t use the egg whites but subsituted real whipping cream instead because let’s face it....real whipping cream makes everything better. I will make this again!

This recipe was a big hit at my lastest church picnic. It was the only dessert that was totally gone and my best friend and her husband had to fight over the last piece,lol... I used the whip cream instead of the egg whites and it worked just fine. It's definately a good idea to make sure it's totally cooled before adding the layers. Also, I used 'pumpkin spice' instead of just cinnamon and sprinkled the top with chopped pecans. I'm getting ready to make this at least another 3 times this season! I highly recommend this recipe!

This is a really nice change from the boring old pumpkin pie! I took it to a family dinner and everyone wanted the recipe. I too omitted the raw egg whites for cool whip and it was fine. I used fresh whipping cream on top which I whipped with 1/2 cup powdered sugar, 1 tsp. vanilla and 1/2 tsp stabilizer which you can find at any cake and candy supply store. The whipped cream will not separate if you use this! Great recipe...will definately make again.

I used the recommended butter but used unsalted butter with 2 cups graham cracker crumbs! Also used original Cool Whip mixed with 1/2 tsp vanilla and 2 tbsp. of powdered sugar. It was absolutely delicious!!! A good change of pumpkin flavor for around Thanksgiving!

Made this for the first time this past Thanksgiving and it was wonderful. Took it to a family gathering and it was the only desert that was completely gone. I added a little clove and ginger to the pumpkin layer, and sprinkled the whip cream with cinnamon for decoration. It was wonderful! Got lots of great comments from others on it.
I used the cool whip instead of the egg whites and it worked great. I ALSO omitted the sugar in the pumpkin layer. The cool whip is sweet enough and we didn't notice the absence of the sugar at all.
Made this to take to Thanksgiving dinner. Everyone said it was great. I had a small piece, and just seemed good. Things taste better when others make it I guess..
To much crust, to little cream cheese that did not mix well..
Fantastic - not overly spiced. Picky crowd of serious bakers all asked for the recipient. I substituted the egg whites for whipped cream (only change)
This recipe is sooo yummy! Everyone I have made if for wants the recipe! Far better than any pumpkin pie I have ever had! This will be the fall recipe I pass down to my kids for sure! Enjoy!!!
This recipe is one of my favorites! I can only make it for large gatherings otherwise I could eat the entire pan! I made no changes.

I attempted to make this recipe and unknown if I did it right it said bake 4 20 min in a preheated oven but did not say what the cheese cake mixture was supposed to look like when it was done. Unknown if I would like the recipe
***** this is delicious--I cook at a Senior Center and the folks just went crazy over this one--delicious!

I liked this but my family didn't. They wanted real pumpkin pie, and this was too light and the crust was strange, not crispy enough I guess. After two days in the frig it started to separate and get watery too.

Yummy! I just made this for our Thanksgiving lunch at church and it turned out wonderful. I thought about following the suggestion about substituting cool whip, but was afraid to vary from the original recipe. I doubled the recipe and and made two large desserts. It turned out to be more than enough for a crowd. Everyone raved about how good it was and wanted the recipe. It was pretty simple to make (just make sure to cool all of the layers COMPLETELY before adding the next...I put them in the freezer to help cool it faster). The only con was that it really did take 3 hours to make, so it is not a quick throw together dessert. I will definitely be making this again.
